rationale: B is more useful because it gives a clearer prioritization, distinguishes among alternatives, and adds an important conditional: load time is critical only if current performance is poor. It also notes execution risk for partnerships, which matters in a one-month launch window. A has a plausible recommendation, but it barely compares options, gives no thresholds or revisit triggers, and lacks caveats beyond a generic claim that shareability drives growth. Neither provides strong quantitative evidence, but B at least offers a rough performance threshold and more decision-relevant tradeoff framing.
